name: orphaned-visual-registry
goal: Visual generation refuses orphaned existing registry entries before creating source

evidence: A new visual scaffold must not silently skip its registry when its source is absent but a unit or scenario file already exists.
The existing workspace generator case covers fresh registration, regeneration and invalid build selection but not orphaned unit or scenario metadata; extend the same case.
At c2d4586cbc the existing case failed because orphaned component metadata did not block generation. Harness red record ef9cd6bd53d656f705f74f615abc156233662b7665c98a93a4efbec42551b051.
